title: Misleading .nvmrc file says '24' but project uses Bun, not Node/nvm
description: Verified: .nvmrc:1 — contains '24', implying Node.js v24 via nvm. The project uses Bun (packageManager: 'bun@1.3.14') and has no nvm-related configuration. This misleads developers into thinking Node/nvm is the runtime. `git status` shows .nvmrc as untracked (`?? .nvmrc`), meaning it was recently added but never committed.
spec:
1. Delete the `.nvmrc` file from the working tree.
2. Verify deletion with `ls .nvmrc` — should report file not found.
3. Verify the Node.js version requirement is already documented in package.json engines field (`"node": ">=24.0.0 <25.0.0"`).
4. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` passes after removal.
notes: Deleted .nvmrc (contained '24', implied Node/nvm usage but project uses Bun). Node version requirement already documented in package.json engines field. Updated spec.md Known Limitations to remove resolved item #6 and renumber remaining items.
